language_rules.register: Formal academic and professional writing. Factual, reflective, and well-structured.
principles: Use objective, precise, and professional language.
Keep every claim consistent with transcripts, CV, and admission documents.
Do not write exaggerated praise or emotional appeals.

banned_phrases: I want to settle in Germany permanently
Any university in Germany is fine
This is only for visa approval
I have no specific academic reason
My sponsor will definitely cover everything without proof
at the end of the day

preferred_replacements.I want PR: I plan to use this qualification to develop my career after graduation.
preferred_replacements.any university is fine: This program best matches my academic interests.
